rca_of_issue: Bug 1 (Ohtani '0-for-7' vs Mets): fetch_batter_h2h previously derived vs-team stats from CURRENT SEASON gameLog only, so Ohtani's 2026 sample against Mets (7 AB, 0 hits) was rendered as the career total. Fix in mlb_batter_h2h.py switches the PRIMARY source to /people/{pid}/stats?stats=vsTeam&opposingTeamId={tid} which returns career totals — the same endpoint StatMuse uses. Verified: 20 hits, 71 AB, .282 avg, 5 HR, 13 RBI in 50 career games (matches StatMuse; StatMuse counts 19 starts, MLB API counts 50 appearances-with-a-PA, delta is expected). Bug 2 (deep-dive recent-row value column empty): H2HPanel.recentValue rendered only r.k (pitcher) or r.result (tennis/soccer) but not batter H-AB. Fix in H2HPanel.tsx:140-148 adds r.stat rendering (pre-formatted by backend as 'h-ab') + inline '  n HR' / '  n RBI' badges when the batter recorded HRs/RBIs; minWidth bumped 40→90 so '1-4  1 HR' fits. Verified end-to-end via Playwright: Ohtani deep-dive shows '0-3' and '0-4' in the right-hand column of the recent rows.
